title: Console Standup embedded in Now panel
description:
## Decision

SD approved embedding standup in the Console **Now** panel (CurrentStatusPanel). No separate Reports navigation entry.

## Scope

- Standup is triggered from the Now panel via a button that opens a drawer.
- Generation uses the shared standup pipeline (same stack as CLI `kbs standup` / `kanbus standup`), not a parallel mock path.
- Profiles: meeting-script and director-brief (inherited from initiative kbs-60f3d0).

## Out of scope

- Reports nav or standalone Reports page for standup.
- Forking a separate LLM client for console standup.

## Dependencies

- Shared standup generation on right-now AI stack (kbs-e7abbe) must be callable from kbsc.
- JIT fail-closed `kbs now` summaries (kbs-0fe175) gate real standup output.

## Child stories

1. Gherkin: Now-panel Standup drawer + API behavior
2. Console API: POST /api/standup shared pipeline
3. Console UI: Standup button + drawer in CurrentStatusPanel

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Closing: all child stories shipped (Console Standup in Now panel). Soft nits under other epics remain separate.

right_now_summary: Console Standup now works in the Now panel with profile selection, shared generation, and safe error handling.
